# Guides that answer the same question do not link to its owner page

Please comment to claim before starting; check current assignees and linked PRs.

## Context

Sub-issue of #20498. It carries out the owner table of the map's row 4, recorded on #20527 ([comment 6873132740](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20527#issuecomment-6873132740)): eleven questions, one owner page each, no page retired. The table left three defects open. All three were read again at `dev` `960f169e4e` on 2026-11-15.

Design authority: #20498 (map row 4), the owner table on #20527, and `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §1, §2 and §4.

Ownership: `unowned-rationale: Ready for a contributor; maintainers provide planning and review.`

## The Problem

`learn/` answers a core question on up to four kinds of page: first contact (`gettingstarted/`), the case (`benefits/`), a workshop tour of six chapters written to be read in a row (`guides/coreengine/`), and the reference (`guides/fundamentals/`, `guides/datahandling/`, `guides/userinteraction/`). Each kind fits its moment. A reader who lands on one cannot reach the others:

- Sixteen links between a page and the owner of its question do not exist (Part 1).
- `learn/tree.json` gives two different pages the name "Instance Lifecycle".
- The reference page on the config system never mentions config descriptors, and its example tests `oldValue !== undefined` (lines 328 and 334) without saying what that means. The reference page on the lifecycle never mentions remote method registration. Today only a tour chapter explains these.
- The tour's lifecycle chapter lists six steps and omits `onAfterConstructed()`. It says `onConstructed()` sets `isConstructed`; the source sets it in `onAfterConstructed()`.

## The Architectural Reality

Facts the texts must agree with. Line numbers are at `dev` `960f169e4e`; paths start at the repository root.

- `Neo.create()` calls `construct()`, `onConstructed()`, `onAfterConstructed()`, `init()` in this order (`src/Neo.mjs`, lines 338 to 341). `onAfterConstructed()` sets `isConstructed = true` and fires `constructed` on an observable class (`src/core/Base.mjs`, lines 829 to 835).
- `initAsync()` in `Neo.core.Base` awaits `initRemote()` when the class has a `remote` config (`src/core/Base.mjs`, lines 621 to 628). That is why an override opens with `await super.initAsync()`.
- In the generated setter, a `beforeSet` hook that returns `undefined` cancels the update (`src/Neo.mjs`, lines 471 to 476), and `afterSet` runs only when `config.set(value)` reports a change (`src/Neo.mjs`, lines 487 to 490; the comparison is `isEqual` in `src/core/Config.mjs`, line 162).
- A descriptor is a config value that carries `[isDescriptor]: true` (`src/core/ConfigSymbols.mjs`; read in `src/Neo.mjs`, line 953). `initDescriptor()` in `src/core/Config.mjs` (lines 90 to 125) takes `clone`, `cloneOnGet`, `isEqual` and `merge` from it.
- `Config#get()` registers the config with the effect that is running (`src/core/Config.mjs`, lines 81 to 86), whichever instance owns the config.
- Guides link to each other with relative Markdown paths, as `learn/guides/fundamentals/ExtendingNeoClasses.md` does on lines 85 and 254. `npm run check-relative-links` resolves them against the git index and runs in `.github/workflows/pr-baseline.yml`.

## The Fix

One pull request with three parts. From here on, paths are under `learn/`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** Each of the sixteen rows of Part 1 holds: the page has a relative Markdown link that resolves to the target, in the section named. `npm run check-relative-links` passes.
- [ ] **AC-2:** In `learn/tree.json` the two `name` values read as in Part 2, with `id` and `parentId` unchanged, and only one page is named "Instance Lifecycle".
- [ ] **AC-3:** Rows a to e of Part 3 are in the two reference pages. The pull request body lists, per row, the source lines it was checked against at the pull request's base.
- [ ] **AC-4:** Row f: the tour's sequence names `onAfterConstructed()`, and the sentence on `isConstructed` stands with it.
- [ ] **AC-5:** No section, example or diagram leaves any page. The diff deletes only the two tree names and the lines of the tour's sequence that row f rewrites.
- [ ] **AC-6:** The added guide text names no ticket or pull request number and does not call Neo a framework.
- [ ] **AC-7:** On the dev server (`npm run server-start`), the portal route `#/learn/guides/fundamentals/ConfigSystemDeepDive` shows the new descriptor section, and one new link, named in the pull request body, is clicked there and lands on its target.

## Out of Scope

- Retiring, merging or renaming a page file, or changing an `id` in `learn/tree.json`.
- Editing or regenerating `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` and `apps/portal/llms.txt`.
- Re-grounding the Getting Started pages. #20528 holds that work, including the class name `Neo.model.Component` in `gettingstarted/ComponentModels.md` (line 54; no such class exists, the class is `Neo.state.Provider`) and two typos in `gettingstarted/Config.md` (lines 58 and 59).
- The other equal names in the tree: "Multi-Window Applications" twice, "Overview" twice, "Events" as a page and as a group.
- A paragraph-by-paragraph comparison of the large pages beyond the rows of Part 3.

## Avoided Traps

- **Copying the tour's sections into the reference.** Two copies of one paragraph drift apart. The reference states the mechanism in its own words and the tour keeps the story.
- **Cutting a tour chapter because the reference now holds its topic.** The six chapters are one telling, each opening on the one before (#9500).
- **Compressing a page until it reads tight.** The guard of #20518 applies: the stronger telling wins per paragraph, and no example or diagram is lost.
